requirement: The Linux userspace fuzzing workflow shall package a selected target binary and its required host-provided shared libraries into an initrd and launch the target through kAFL. An embedded forkserver shall translate kAFL hypercalls into AFL-style guest I/O to support target execution and fuzzing feedback.

The Windows Hyper-V fuzzing workflow shall create a fuzzing snapshot, load and execute the packet-sending helper, and deliver fuzzing payloads from a child-partition harness to the root-partition VMSwitch target. It shall operate across the child and root partition virtual-machine roles.
When a monitored crash occurs in the root partition during Windows fuzzing, the system shall return crash status or equivalent monitoring results to the hAFL2 controller.

The fuzzer shall support deterministic mutation of byte payloads with optional boolean effector maps. Mutation processing shall restore the original input contents on completion, and each deterministic bit-flip mutation shall change the specified number of bits.
The Windows fuzzing harness shall support build-specific target offset values set before compilation to match the selected Windows build.
